concerns.text: FR-009 (log exclusion decisions) and SC-001 (report Pearson r) lack explicit task coverage. T018, T019, T020 are marked as missing/unchecked in the provided text, and T017 (report Pearson r) is unchecked. Without these tasks, the system cannot satisfy the logging and reporting requirements.

FR-005 (full regression with covariates) and SC-003 (ΔR² precision) are not fully covered. T051 implements the regression but T017.1 (ΔR² formatting) and T043 (format_delta_r2 implementation) are unchecked. The spec requires 4 decimal places; the task to implement this formatter is not marked complete.

FR-008 (diagnostic visualisations) and SC-004 (≤5MB plots) are not covered. T022, T023, T057, T058 are unchecked. The spec requires specific plots (scatter, residuals, QQ) and file size constraints; no tasks are marked complete to implement these.

FR-006 (permutation test), FR-007 (FWE correction), FR-010 (sensitivity analysis), SC-002, SC-005 are not covered. T027, T045, T046, T030, T031 are unchecked. The spec requires 10k permutations, max-T correction, and sensitivity tables; no tasks are marked complete.

Stale or duplicate task definitions: T045 and T046 are defined in Phase 5 and again in Phase N with identical descriptions. T047 and T048 in Phase N duplicate the requirements of T022/T023/T057. This creates confusion and potential implementation gaps.
